newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to join WTO this week.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to join WTO this week.

text.p: Bulgaria is expected to sign a membership accord with the World Trade Organisation (WTO) in Geneva on Wednesday, Trade Minister Atanas Paparizov said on Tuesday.
"I hope the WTO council will vote unanimously to admit Bulgaria in the organization," Paparizov told reporters at Sofia airport on departure to Geneva.
Bulgaria, which liberalised trade after the collapse of the centralised economy six years ago, has met most of WTO membership requirements so far.

Several of years of talks have brought the country close to the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), which in 1995 was absorbed by the WTO, set up with the aim of slashing tariffs on goods and opening up trade in services. -- Elisaveta Konstantinova, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
